chunks: That you will climb from stage to stage.

key_terms.طَبَقًا: A layer, stage, or level (of something, such as Hell or Paradise)
key_terms.طَبَقٍ: A layer, stage, or level (genitive case)

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'from stage to stage' mean in Surah Al-Infitar?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the structured, tiered nature of Hell (Jahannam), where punishment intensifies according to the degree of disbelief and sin, reflecting divine justice. It contrasts with the ascending ranks (Darajat) of the righteous in Paradise, illustrating the cosmic symmetry between the two abodes. The phrase 'layer upon layer' underscores the inevitability and precision of the Hereafter's retribution.
